Wavetile design system

Generated from DesignSystem/Theme.swift, Motion.swift, Glyph.swift and Components/ by scripts/design-system.py. The descriptions are the code's own doc comments, and every “Used in” list is a scan of the app's Swift files. Views read all of this via @Environment(\.theme). Values shown are the Dark theme's; Light changes colors only.

Color

Every visual decision in the app flows from a Theme. To rebrand: edit Theme.dark below, or add a new static theme and pick it in Settings → Appearance. Views read tokens via @Environment(\.theme); they never hard-code colors, fonts, spacing, radii, or animations.

Motion

Named animations. Tune feel here instead of sprinkling .spring(...) through views. Follows Apple's fluid-interface guidance (WWDC18 "Designing Fluid Interfaces"): - UI that just changes state uses critically damped springs (damping 1.0): no overshoot. - Bounce is reserved for motion that follows a gesture with momentum (momentum(initialVelocity:)).

TokenStandardUsed in
motion.snappy

Taps, toggles, small state changes. Critically damped.

.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 1)

.spring(response: 0.12, dampingFraction: 1)

  • DesignSystem/Components/PrimaryButton.swift:26.animation(pressed ? theme.motion.pressIn : theme.motion.snappy, value: pressed)

Icons

App iconography: Phosphor Bold (https://phosphoricons.com), bundled as 24pt template vectors in Resources/Icons.xcassets. Views use semantic names (.library), never asset names, so swapping an icon or the whole set is a one-line change here. To add one: put its Phosphor name in scripts/fetch-icons.sh, run the script, and add a case.

SideDrawer
SideDrawer.swift		Twitter-style reveal drawer: the main content slides aside to uncover drawer underneath. - edge is the side the drawer lives on: .leading slides content right (Twitter/X), .trailing slides it left. - Tap or drag the content to close; swipe in from edge to open while edgeSwipeEnabled. For .leading, enable it only on root screens so it never fights the system back gesture. - The content gets rounded corners and dims as it slides; feel is tuned via Theme.motion. - With VoiceOver, the hidden layer is removed from the accessibility tree, and the two-finger "escape" gesture closes the drawer.
